mapper.update:
update eg_contract set
payable_device_amount = #{param.payableDeviceAmount},
receivable_service_amount = #{param.receivableServiceAmount},
actual_service_amount = actual_service_amount + #{param.actualServiceAmount},
account_date = #{param.accountDate}, depreciation_reserves_amount_kp = #{param.depreciationReservesAmountKp}, depreciation_reserves_amount_sk = #{param.depreciationReservesAmountSk}, outtax_amount = #{param.outtaxAmount}, lease_revenue_amount = #{param.leaseRevenueAmount}, tax_amount = #{param.taxAmount}, receivable_vendor_procedure_amount = #{param.receivableVendorProcedureAmount} where id = #{param.id}
mapper.select:
select * from eg_contract a where 1 = 1
and to_char(financial_contract_status_update_time,'YYYY-MM') = to_char(to_date(#{param.financialContractStatusUpdateTime},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM')

select a.id, a.contract_code, a.contract_name, a.client_code, a.client_name, a.org_id, a.client_type, a.lease_date_start, lease_date_end, a.business_code, a.business_name, a.invoice_type, a.industry, a.lease_type, a.contract_status, interest_rate_type, a.classification_five, a.provision_type, a.return_type, a.domestic_entrance, a.project_differentiate, business_plate, a.province_city, a.currency_type, a.contract_amount, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, del_flag, a.lease_interest_rate_year,outtax_balance, a.lease_revenue_balance, a.depreciation_loss_balance, a.payable_service from eg_contract a inner join sys_dict_data dict on a.org_id = dict.dict_value and dict.dict_type ='company' inner join eg_contract_status_record_temp b on a.contract_code = b.contract_code and dict.dict_label = b.org_id where a.del_flag ='0'

select ec.contract_code, ec.contract_name from eg_contract ec where 1 = 1 and ec.del_flag = '0'
and ec.contract_code like concat('%', #{param.contractCode}::text, '%')
and ec.contract_name like concat('%', #{param.contractName}::text, '%')
and ec.contract_name like concat('%', #{param.searchKey}::text, '%') or ec.contract_code like concat('%', #{param.searchKey}::text, '%')
union all select eoc.contract_code, eoc.contract_name from eg_offline_contract eoc where 1 = 1 and eoc.del_flag = '0' and eoc.process_status in ('3','4')
and eoc.contract_code like concat('%', #{param.contractCode}::text, '%')
and eoc.contract_name like concat('%', #{param.contractName}::text, '%')
and eoc.contract_name like concat('%', #{param.searchKey}::text, '%') or eoc.contract_code like concat('%', #{param.searchKey}::text, '%')

select ec.contract_code, ec.client_code, ec.org_id, ec.client_type, ec.lease_date_start, ec.lease_date_end, ec.business_code, ec.business_name, ec.invoice_type, ec.industry, ec.lease_type, ec.contract_status, ec.system_code, sdd.dict_label as system_code_name, ec2.client_name, eoc.org_name as org_id_name from eg_contract ec left join eg_client ec2 on ec.client_code = ec2.client_code and ec2.del_flag = '0' left join eg_org_company eoc on ec.org_id = eoc.org_id and eoc.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dict_data sdd on ec.system_code = sdd.dict_value and sdd.dict_type = 'sys_form_source' where 1 = 1 and ec.del_flag = '0' and (ec.contract_code_m IS NULL OR ec.contract_code_m ='' OR ec.contract_code = ec.contract_code_m)
and ec.system_code in
#{item}
and ec.contract_code like concat('%', #{param.contractCode}::text, '%')
and ec2.client_name like concat('%', #{param.clientName}::text, '%')
and ec.org_id in
#{item}
and ec.contract_status in
#{item}
and ec.contract_status in
#{item}
and ec.financial_contract_status in
#{item}
and to_char(ec.business_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(#{param.businessDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ec.business_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(#{param.businessDateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ec.lease_date_start,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(#{param.leaseDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ec.lease_date_end,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(#{param.leaseDateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ec.lease_date_start,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(to_date(#{param.leaseDateStartDate},'yyyy-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ec.lease_date_start,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.leaseDateStartEndDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ec.lease_date_end,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(to_date(#{param.leaseDateEndStartDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ec.lease_date_end,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.leaseDateEndEndDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
order by ec.lease_date_start desc nulls last
select ec.client_code from eg_contract ec where 1 = 1 and ec.del_flag = '0' and ec.contract_code = #{contractCode} and ec.client_name = #{clientName} order by ec.client_code limit 1
